titulo: Carrying the kind thing over to her
caption:
Carrying the kind thing over to her

Someone at work said something kind about her, and it never reached her. My friend carried it over.

A good word only helps the person who hears it, and passing it on takes a sentence.

For whoever passes along the kind thing they heard.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.
